body:
The Samsung Galaxy S26 FE starts at US$699.99 in the United States, with a 256 GB variant at US$799.99. It went on sale through select carriers on 3 September 2026 and nationwide from Samsung.com, carriers and retailers on 4 September.

Specifications

  • Chip: Exynos 2500 on a 3 nanometre process, in the US model per Samsung's listing.
  • Display: 6.7 inches with Gorilla Glass Victus+.
  • Battery: 4,900 mAh, up to 29 hours of video playback, with 45 W wired charging that Samsung says reaches a substantial charge in about 30 minutes.
  • Camera: a 50 megapixel main sensor.
  • Memory: 8 GB of RAM, with storage options listed up to 512 GB.

Where it fits

FE stands for Fan Edition: a flagship-style phone with trimmed specs at a lower price. In Europe the base model was listed at EUR 800, so prices differ by market.

Buying notes

Compare with the previous generation, which retailers discount heavily after a successor launches, as TechRadar points out for the S25 FE.
